"Similar checks" (step 2) - I never saw this screen, so I don't know what it is for.
"If it does several things, pick the one where it has the most freedom" - I was not sure what "freedom" means for a tool like this.
"pick the one nearest the bottom of this list" - the logic is odd and I did not follow why.

expectNext: I think it goes to a result telling me whether I can go ahead with the loan tool, plus a list of what has to be done first. It will probably check my answers against the firm's rules before that, perhaps with a confirm step. I don't expect anything to be sent or approved yet.
ticksMean: I think a tick means I looked at the answer the helper filled in and agree with it. Without that, I guess it would not count as my answer. I'm not sure if ticking has any other effect.
